item.title: Hikone Castle Cherry Blossoms: 1,000 Trees Around a National Treasure — Guide
item.description: Hikone Castle in cherry-blossom season is one of Shiga’s most beautiful sights: around 1,000 cherry trees bloom across the castle hill, ramparts and the surrounding moats each early April, framing the National Treasure keep in clouds of pale pink. The classic view is from the inner and outer moats, where boat rides and moat-side paths set the blossoms against the castle’s stone walls and the petals drift down to carpet the water, and the whole scene is lit after dark for yozakura evening viewing, making Hikone a fixture on lists of Japan’s finest hanami spots.
